summary.en: US markets show mixed sentiment as investors digest hot inflation data from earlier in the week. AI sector faces pressure from CoreWeave credit stress concerns while traditional sectors like energy and precious metals benefit from rate-sensitive positioning. Futures indicate cautious optimism with S&P 500 ETFs rising, Nasdaq edging higher on Tesla gains, but broader tech weighing on sentiment.
summary.zh: 美股市场呈现混合情绪，投资者正在消化本周早些时候公布的通胀数据。AI 行业因 CoreWeave 信用压力而承压，而能源和贵金属等传统板块受益于利率敏感型配置。期货显示谨慎乐观：SPY 上涨，纳指因特斯拉获利微涨，但科技板块整体拖累情绪。

title.en: CoreWeave Credit Stress Intensifies, AI Sector Repricing Continues
title.zh: CoreWeave 信用压力加剧，AI 板块重新定价持续

impact.en: Credit-default swap spreads at CoreWeave widened significantly, signaling market concerns over private equity-backed AI infrastructure financing. This cascades to semiconductor and cloud infrastructure stocks as investors reassess AI debt sustainability.
impact.zh: CoreWeave 的信贷违约互换价差显著扩大，显示市场对私募股权支持的 AI 基础设施融资的担忧。这传导至半导体和云基础设施股票，投资者正在重新评估 AI 债务可持续性。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Credit stress in PE-backed AI infrastructure → inflation expectations reset → Treasury yield dynamics
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 私募股权支持的 AI 基础设施信贷压力→通胀预期重置→美债收益率动态

title.en: S&P 500 ETFs Rise as Investors Pare Rate-Hike Bets
title.zh: 标普 500ETF 上涨，投资者减少对加息押注

impact.en: Hot inflation data earlier this week has been absorbed, with investors now betting on Fed pause or cuts. This supports broader market but creates divergence as yield-sensitive rate plays out.
impact.zh: 本周早些时候公布的通胀数据已被吸收，投资者现在押注美联储暂停或降息。这支持了更广泛的市场，但随着收益率敏感型配置展开，造成分化。

macroRisk.en: No - Inflation data absorption supports market stability
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 通胀数据吸收支持市场稳定

title.en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Remains Silent on Interest Rates
title.zh: 美联储主席沃什对利率保持沉默

impact.en: Fed Chair's quiet signals patience or limited policy changes ahead. Markets interpret this as neutral-to-slightly hawkish, tempering rate-cut enthusiasm while supporting price stability focus.
impact.zh: 美联储主席的沉默信号耐心或政策变化有限。市场将其解读为中性至略偏鹰派，抑制降息热情，同时支持价格稳定焦点。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Fed policy uncertainty → volatility in long-duration bonds and growth stocks
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 货币政策不确定性→长期债券和成长股的波动

title.en: Gold Rebounds to $4,182 as USD Weakens

impact.en: Dollar index at 101.88 supports precious metals rally. Safe-haven flows into gold offset by some AI-driven tech risk-off, creating mixed but positive momentum for miners and bullion traders.
impact.zh: 美元指数在 101.88 支持贵金属反弹。避险资金流入黄金被一些 AI 驱动的科技公司风险规避部分抵消，为矿业商和现货交易商创造了混合但积极的势头。

macroRisk.en: No - Safe haven flows align with weaker USD and lower yields
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 避险资金流向与较弱美元和较低收益率一致

title.en: WTI Oil Slips to $95.39 on Global Demand Concerns
title.zh: WTI 原油跌至$95.39，全球需求担忧

impact.en: Oil demand softness amid economic uncertainty weighs on energy sector. OPEC+ production discipline provides floor, but growth outlook dampens upside. Energy stocks remain defensive vs growth.
impact.zh: 经济不确定性导致石油需求疲软拖累能源板块。OPEC+ 生产纪律提供了支撑，但增长前景抑制上涨。能源股票相对于成长股保持防御性。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Oil demand → inflation expectations → Fed policy stance
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 石油需求→通胀预期→美联储政策立场

title.en: Nasdaq Futures Mixed: Tech Wobbles, Tesla Gains
title.zh: 纳斯达克期货混合：科技波动，特斯拉上涨

impact.en: Mixed premarket with tech sector showing internal divergence. AI hardware and data centers lag while EVs (TSLA) and consumer staples show resilience. Semiconductor stocks hit after earlier selloff.
impact.zh: 盘前混合，科技板块显示内部分化。AI 硬件和数据中心落后，而电动车（TSLA）和消费品表现出韧性。半导体股票在前期抛售后受到打击。

macroRisk.en: Mixed - Tech divergence reflects broader macro uncertainty with sector-specific catalysts
macroRisk.zh: 混合 - 科技板块分化反映了更广泛的宏观不确定性和行业特定催化剂

title.en: Semiconductor Sector Under Pressure After Heavy Selloff
title.zh: 半导体板块在大幅抛售后承压

impact.en: Semiconductor stocks hit hardest by AI jitters and supply chain concerns. Design firms outperform pure-play chipmakers as investors favor profitability over growth narratives.
impact.zh: 半导体股票最受 AI 担忧和供应链问题影响。设计公司优于纯芯片制造商，投资者更青睐盈利而非增长叙事。

macroRisk.en: Yes - AI spending concerns → semiconductor demand dynamics → growth stock positioning
macroRisk.zh: 是 - AI 支出担忧→半导体需求动态→成长股配置

ai.en: AI sector showing signs of stress with CoreWeave credit issues dominating headlines. Private equity-backed AI infrastructure financing under question, causing repricing across cloud/AI compute stocks. Selective rotation into profitability-focused names (SMCI, AVGO) away from growth-at-any-cost narratives.
ai.zh: AI 板块显示压力迹象，CoreWeave 信用问题主导头条。私募股权支持的 AI 基础设施融资受到质疑，导致云/AI 计算股票重新定价。选择性轮动到盈利能力聚焦名称（SMCI、AVGO），远离不惜代价增长叙事。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductor stocks under pressure following heavy selloff. Design firms showing more resilience than pure-play chipmakers. Supply chain concerns and AI spending skepticism weigh on sector, but cyclical recovery dynamics remain intact.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体股票在大幅抛售后承压。设计公司表现出比纯芯片制造商更强的韧性。供应链担忧和 AI 支出怀疑影响板块，但周期性复苏动态保持完好。

bigTech.en: Big Tech showing mixed sentiment with consumer-focused names (PEP, KO) outperforming. Cloud/AI infrastructure plays lagging due to CoreWeave concerns. Rate-sensitive capital intensive businesses benefit from lower yield environment but face growth narrative challenges.
bigTech.zh: 大型科技呈现混合情绪，消费者聚焦名称（PEP、KO）表现更好。云/AI 基础设施因 CoreWeave 担忧而落后。利率敏感资本密集型企业从较低收益率环境受益，但面临增长叙事挑战。

energy.en: Energy sector providing defensive positioning amid macro uncertainty. WTI at $95.39 offers floor, OPEC+ discipline provides support. Sector outpacing growth as recession fears elevate. Refiners and integrated majors benefit from stable margins in volatile market.
energy.zh: 能源板块在宏观不确定性下提供防御性配置。WTI 在$95.39 提供支撑，OPEC+ 纪律提供支持。随着衰退担忧上升，该板块跑赢成长股。炼油商和综合大企业在波动市场中受益于稳定的利润率。

ev.en: EV sector mixed with TSLA gaining while broader auto/manufacturing faces headwinds. Consumer demand uncertainty weighs on outlook, though production cuts and inventory normalization offer some support. Policy tailwinds from incentives remain relevant.
ev.zh: EV 板块混合，特斯拉上涨而更广泛的汽车/制造业面临阻力。消费者需求不确定性影响前景，尽管生产削减和库存正常化提供一定支持。激励政策顺风仍相关。

market.en: Broad market mixed with S&P 500 ETFs (SPY) rising while Nasdaq shows weakness. Investors digesting hot inflation data from earlier in week, now pausing for Fed speakers and rate dynamics. Defensive rotation evident with energy/precious metals outperforming.
market.zh: 大盘混合，标普 500ETF（SPY）上涨而纳斯达克显示疲软。投资者消化本周早些时候的通胀数据，现在等待美联储发言人和利率动态。防御性轮动明显，能源和贵金属跑赢。

preciousMetals.en: Precious metals rallying with gold at ~$4,182 supported by weaker dollar (DXY 101.88) and lower yields. Safe-haven flows offset by tech risk-off concerns. Silver mining companies showing resilience as industrial demand normalizes alongside financial attributes.
preciousMetals.zh: 贵金属反弹，黄金在约$4,182，受较弱美元（DXY 101.88）和较低收益率支持。避险资金流入被科技风险规避担忧抵消。白银矿业公司表现出韧性，随着金融属性工业需求正常化。

oil.en: Oil markets at $95.39 (WTI) under pressure from demand softness but supported by OPEC+ production discipline. Geopolitical risk premium provides floor, but global growth concerns cap upside. Energy stocks outperforming tech as recession hedge preference dominates.
oil.zh: 油价市场$95.39（WTI）因需求疲软而承压，但得到 OPEC+ 生产纪律支持。地缘政治风险溢价提供支撑，但全球增长担忧抑制上涨。能源股票跑赢科技股，作为衰退避险偏好占主导。

futures.en: Mixed: Dow edges up at open, S&P 500 ETF (SPY) rising, Nasdaq showing weakness. Tech sector wobbles while Tesla and consumer staples provide support.
futures.zh: 混合：道指早盘上涨，标普 500ETF（SPY）上涨，纳斯达克显示疲软。科技板块波动，而特斯拉和消费品提供支持。

treasury10Y.en: US 10Y yield inching lower as investors absorb hot inflation data. Treasury yields sensitive to Fed policy expectations and duration positioning.
treasury10Y.zh: 美国 10 年期收益率小幅下降，投资者吸收通胀数据。美债收益率对美联储政策预期和期限配置敏感。

dxy.en: Dollar index eased to 101.88, supporting precious metals rally. Weak USD aligns with yield dynamics and inflation absorption.
dxy.zh: 美元指数回落至 101.88，支持贵金属反弹。较弱美元与收益率动态和通胀吸收一致。

oil.en: WTI crude at $95.39 under pressure from demand concerns but supported by geopolitical risk premium and OPEC+ discipline.
oil.zh: WTI 原油在$95.39，受需求担忧压力，但得到地缘政治风险溢价和 OPEC+ 纪律支持。

keyRisk.en: CoreWeave credit stress and AI infrastructure financing sustainability remain primary concerns. Fed Chair Warsh silence creates policy uncertainty. Inflation data implications for rate expectations are key focus.
keyRisk.zh: CoreWeave 信用压力和 AI 基础设施融资可持续性仍然是主要担忧。美联储主席沃什沉默造成政策不确定性。通胀数据对利率预期的影响是关键焦点。

note.en: Mixed sentiment driven by defensive rotation (energy, precious metals) vs growth weakness (tech/AI). Inflation data absorption creates some stability while CoreWeave stress and AI spending concerns introduce volatility. Fed policy direction remains key determinant for regime shift.
note.zh: 混合情绪由防御性轮动（能源、贵金属）与成长疲软（科技/AI）驱动。通胀数据吸收创造了一些稳定性，而 CoreWeave 压力和 AI 支出担忧引入波动。美联储政策方向仍然是制度转变的关键决定因素。
